name: Now Playing
description: Control Spotify from Orca: the desktop app on macOS, or any device through the Spotify Web API. Not affiliated with Spotify.

settings.title: Backend
settings.description: How Now Playing reaches Spotify. Auto uses the desktop app on macOS and the Spotify Web API elsewhere.

settings.title: Spotify Client ID

settings.title: Redirect port
settings.description: Port of the login redirect, http://127.0.0.1:<port>/callback. Change it only if 43117 is taken, and add the new address to your Spotify app.
